page.title: Example Telemetry Data
page.description: Example lap and turn/corner CSVs recorded by PyFyTelemetry F1: one offline race and one online race, every lap and every corner.
page.intro_html: The below examples are two sessions for two of the supported tracks: an offline race against AI at Abu Dhabi and an online multiplayer race on a 14-car grid at Baku. Open the interactive viewer for the full tables.
page.outro_html: Every column of both files is described in the CSV output schema.

files.label: Abu Dhabi Laps
files.description: Each lap records total time, sector times, gap ahead and gap behind, tyre compound and age, temperature windows, AI difficulty, position, weather, lap type, assists, damage, lockups, spins, flashbacks, DRS or S-Mode, penalties, battery deployed and harvested, and more. Additionally, whether the session was online or offline (and whether the grid was human or AI).

files.label: Abu Dhabi Turns
files.description: Each turn of every lap: entry, apex and exit timings, distances, speeds and gears; race position and gaps ahead and behind at entry and exit; lockups and wheelspins by severity and axle; tyre temperatures, brake bias, differential; battery deployed and recovered; collisions, corner cuts and penalties; and the spatial samples for technique charts.
